updates.title: Welcome to StratoBusters!
updates.content:
We are excited to announce the launch of our CanSat project website. This marks the beginning of an incredible journey into the stratosphere.

What's Next?

Our team is working hard on the initial design phase, and we'll be sharing regular updates about our progress. Stay tuned!

updates.title: Project Kickoff
updates.content:
The StratoBusters team has officially started the CanSat project. We've completed our initial planning and are ready to begin development.

Initial Goals

  • Design the satellite structure
  • Select and integrate sensors
  • Develop communication systems
  • Plan the launch mission
